Excellent! All 295 tests passing. The `renderInvoiceText` function has been successfully enhanced with the following improvements:

## Enhanced renderInvoiceText Features

**Line Discounts:**
```
5x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
  Discount: -€42.50
```
- Shows indented discount line only when discount > 0
- Calculated automatically for both per-line and tier discounts

**Voucher:**
```
Voucher: -€50.00
Total: €462.75
```
- Shows voucher line before total when present

**Due Date:**
```
Due: 2026-11-06
```
- Added at end when invoice has dueDate

**Paid Amount:**
```
Paid: €350.00
```
- Shows total amount paid (aggregates multiple payments)
- Added at end when invoice has payments

**Complete Example Output:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
5x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €425.00
  Discount: -€42.50
VAT: €80.31
Voucher: -€50.00
Total: €412.81
Due: 2026-11-06
Paid: €250.00
```

**Test Coverage:** 8 new tests added covering:
- Line discount display (present and absent)
- Voucher display
- Due date display
- Paid amount with single and multiple payments
- Combined display of all features
- Draft invoice without due/paid info
